transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to finalize the weekend production plan for 480 pump housings in Assembly Cell 8. As a reminder, we have one Saturday shift and one Sunday shift, each up to 8 hours, with two operators per shift. Before I approve the final roster and production controls, I need to hear from workforce coordination, maintenance, and quality on any constraints that could affect our plan. Let's start with workforce coordination — what do we need to know about operator availability?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a certification constraint for Cell 8 this weekend. The current certification matrix shows that Saturday's Cell 8 roster must be Lina, who is setup-certified, and Sam, who is run-certified. Sunday's roster must be Ruth, who is setup-certified, and Omar, who is run-certified. I checked the matrix after the last training audit, but the updated roster has not yet been attached to the weekend work order, so I want to make sure everyone is aware of this before we lock the plan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance constraint for Cell 8 this weekend. During my morning walkaround inspection, I found that Cell 8's conveyor servo requires a 90-minute preventive inspection that needs to be performed between the Saturday and Sunday shifts. I recorded this finding in my maintenance notebook, but I have not yet entered it in the electronic work order system, so I want everyone to be aware of it now before we lock the plan. This means we need to account for a 90-minute maintenance window between shifts.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a quality constraint for Cell 8 this weekend. The customer quality amendment requires 12 first-off units after the weekend setup, and 100% torque verification on the first 30 units after the maintenance restart, with quality signoff before the remaining units are released. I received the signed amendment by email, but it has not yet been linked to the order record, so I want everyone to be aware of these requirements before we lock the plan.
transcript.speaker: A4
